helpers.note: test instrumentation: adds to a thread-local counter of cell steps and candidate blocks that the traversal tests read to bound the walk's work; a no-op outside cfg(test), it has no effect on any result and vanilla has nothing like it

engine constructor: builds a BlockVoxelShape from boxes already in world coordinates by subtracting the block origin to recover the in-block boxes; vanilla never makes this conversion (it holds the in-block shape and moves it with VoxelShape.move, which BlockVoxelShape::new cites)

recovers the block a box of the engine's flat obstacle list came from by flooring its min corner, so the boxes of one block can be regrouped into its whole shape; vanilla keeps the BlockPos with each shape and has no such inverse
maps the engine's Axis to 0, 1, 2 to index the engine's per-axis arrays (collided flags, grid line lists); vanilla indexes by the enum itself and has no method for it

wraps a join's DiscreteShape as the engine's VoxelShape, caching the boxes its forAllBoxes merge gives (DiscreteShape::boxes, which cites VoxelShape.forAllBoxes) with zero grid origins; vanilla's ArrayVoxelShape holds the discrete shape directly and has no box cache to fill

test-only API: turns every box of the engine shape by a number of quarter turns about Y around the block center; only tests call it, and vanilla's Shapes.rotate only exists from 1.21.5 and rotates the discrete shape, not boxes
test-only API: quarter turns about X around the block center, as rotated_y_quarters; only tests call it and it mirrors no vanilla method
test-only API: quarter turns about Z around the block center, as rotated_y_quarters; only tests call it and it mirrors no vanilla method
applies a box rotation (quarters mod 4) to every box, local box and grid origin of the engine shape and drops any join, for the test-only rotated_*_quarters; mirrors no vanilla method
one quarter turn of a box about Y in unit-block coordinates, (x, z) to (1 - z, x), via its eight corners; used only by the test-only rotations, no vanilla method
one quarter turn of a box about X in unit-block coordinates, (y, z) to (1 - z, y), via its eight corners; used only by the test-only rotations, no vanilla method
one quarter turn of a box about Z in unit-block coordinates, (x, y) to (y, 1 - x), via its eight corners; used only by the test-only rotations, no vanilla method
componentwise min and max of eight points as an engine Aabb, for the test-only box rotations; vanilla has no corner-set bounds method
the number of cells of an engine line list (its length less one); vanilla reads size() - 1 of the DoubleList inline and has no method for it
reads x, y or z of an engine Vec3 by axis index 0..2 so the 1.13.2 shape code can loop over axes; 1.13.2 reads the named fields (minX, maxY, ...) inline and has no indexed getter
field constructor of the engine's legacy Shape from its three line lists and cell flags; the callers (create, empty, moved) cite the vanilla methods whose result it holds

fills the engine's cell vector, x outermost, from a predicate over cell indices; a generic builder the callers (create, over, of_cubes, only_first) give their vanilla rule to, itself no vanilla method

rebuilds a block's 1.13.2 shape from the engine's stored grid lines and boxes (via over), since the engine keeps boxes where vanilla keeps the VoxelShape itself; a conversion between engine representations

marks each cell of the given lines full where one of the boxes holds the cell's center, turning the engine's boxes back into cells; vanilla never converts boxes to cells this way (it keeps the discrete shape)
